name: Suresh & Divya
message: Dearest Vishnuraj & Josly, may your journey together be blessed with endless happiness, prosperity, and love! Cannot wait to celebrate with you at Chiramel Auditorium!

name: Anoop & Meera
message: Wishing you both a lifetime of shared dreams, laughter, and divine grace. May your union be as auspicious and enduring as tradition. Heartfelt congratulations Vishnuraj & Josly!

name: Ashwin & Sneha
message: So overjoyed to celebrate this unforgettable chapter with you in Vaikom! May every tomorrow bring deeper friendship and boundless joy. Cheers to a wonderful lifetime ahead!

name: Marykutty Chacko
message: Dearest Josly and Vishnuraj, may God shower your marriage with abundant peace, good health, and heavenly blessings. So proud and delighted for you both!
